prompt: The agent in shop/ will need a `WEATHER_API_TOKEN` at runtime in every environment. Make sure deploys put it into the app's Secret. I'll put the values into our .env.<env> files myself; no secret value goes into the repository.

checks.why: only the manifest's secrets.keys are exported from an env file into the Secret

checks.expr: all(k in get(data, 'secrets.keys', []) for k in ('OPENAI_API_KEY', 'JUDGE_API_KEY', 'POSTGRES_DSN', 'API_KEY', 'LANGSMITH_API_KEY'))

checks.why: secrets never go into chart values
a runtime secret is not an outbound API declaration

reference: Add WEATHER_API_TOKEN to `secrets.keys` in graph-agents-cli-manifest.yaml (keep the existing keys). `secrets apply --env <env>` (and a direct deploy) then export it from `.env.<env>` into the `<release>-app` Secret; nothing goes into values files. Tell the user to add it to each .env.<env> and run `graph-agents-cli secrets apply --env <env>` (then `deploy --restart`).
